Name: Futa Valley
Author: Ralphy
Description:
[center][color=#ff7700][size=4][b][u]UPDATE[/u][/b][/size][/color][/center]
[size=4][b]Futa Valley - MILF Edition is now out![/b][/size]
This version has all of the contents of the original Futa Valley with bonus portraits for Robin, Caroline, Jodi, and Marnie.

It's intended for use with the '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32397]OO's Anime Style Skimpy Portraits[/url]' mod by TwoCircles

New example screenshots have been added to the gallery - download and play to find more!

I am still working on the sprite updates for the Gender-bent counterparts (Demetrius, Lewis, Pierre and Kent) - since the sprites are extra curvy, they are challenging to fit on the existing characters. I have a plan to address this though!

[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod patches compatibility between Harem Valley and Bountiful Beauties Vol. 1 and 2. Instead of switching back to their original version during Valley Girls scenes, the gender-swapped bachelors instead have some new growth...[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation Instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]1. Install Harem Valley (standalone version - Valley Girls is not needed)[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]2. Install the Harem Valley Unfaithful MPM Patch from the Unfaithful Valley Girls - MILFs and Poly Addon mod (overwrite existing files)[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]3. Install this mod which will overwrite the Harem Valley configuration again[/color]

[size=4][b]Main Features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]-Custom portraits for Valley Girls and Harem Valley scenes, aligning with Bountiful Beauties character design [/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]-Patched sprites for bachelorettes, and new sprites for bachelors during Valley Girls sex scenes.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]-New portraits for Valley Girls unique events (nude beach, saloon)[/color][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]-New portraits for Unfaithful Valley NTR dialogue (Valley Girls scenes when bachelorette is player's girlfriend, fiancé, or wife)[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]-New portraits for Abigail for Spring, Winter, and the Beach (she's had some growth of her own)[/color]

[size=4][b]Upcoming Enhancements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Items I've either started working on, or plan to begin soon:[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]-Animated portrait version[/color][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][s]-Inclusion of the MILFs (Caroline, Jodi, Robin, and Marnie) with character aesthetic matching TwoCircles Anime Style Skimpy Portraits [/s][/color][color=#38761d][b]DONE[/b][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]-New portraits for Unfaithful Valley Poly dialogue (Caroline x Abigail, Haley x Emily, Maru x Penny, etc)[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b][size=4]Potential Future Roadmap[/size][/b][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Options I may consider for future development:[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]- Updating Valley Girls/Harem Valley bachelorette sprites to match Bountiful Beauties hairstyles[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Netorare Valley support[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]- New custom portraits, custom events[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Let me know what you'd be interested in by leaving an endorsement and posting in the comments![/color]
